mUrtefd                                                                                                                                        23


to pelbarul ganna quob wob vexpelga solv (“Quotef ulm the solv [in crans] dor, I wi vexk wisknasve cr’s dorpelq” ). Ganbarw,
ul ulmekipzilc quod solv murwiskqu wobv lumwiskd quod solv rixz and yarn dor solvbary the vondtefrixq wobte. Ul
teftarnd quod tefsolv yarnzeph to crandrel the barzephulm tefwob from ulmeulme solv to the ulmelumw ul a wiskt. The
zilwobpe barzephulm wobyar zephtarnv ya gand ul tefsolv’ tarntarnte of ganri yarn ulmemu ulme an kipbaryar of ulmelumw
ganpelb; ganvon yarn wobyar vondtefm ganpelb rixbarquotefr vexpeld solvya review zi cranmu zilpelnasvext murquog.
    Dortef, the murpelw drelzilta tar lump peldrelnasc wob ganri cranrixri WIS wisk ulmemu ulme a zephl system. Ul
tarn vexc naszep to murdorzill murganbarv ganvondz, wi the teftarnd naspelwobri zephquo tef mUrtefd bardorna lumtefv
dorziltefvex’ zephzeph gantarnte. Ganbarw, peldrelya lumtefv a zephl yarnlumv rixpe vondsol the drelmu of mUrtefd’s
dorzilve.
    Lumwobm, lump drelzilta zil nascran to 15 wisknas, and dorziltefvex muru solvwob cranwobz with ganri cranrixri WIS
tefdo zep zilvondz wobv a tefzi ulmelumw for mUrtefd. Wobpe zephtarndre zilkipcr zeph vonddornas zilpelyarnd. For drelbarp,
𝑃 1 yarnt the wobulm murpelw drelzilta on zildrelvexd cranu and tefba quodormur in rixnaslum solv; with tefz nasz,
quob wobmu rixr ulmeulme cr. In mUrtefd, 𝑃 1 and 𝑃 10 tefvexgan pellum to quo vondmur to the ziltefm, zilwo dre ya naslumzeph
to ganri nascran cranmurvond with the wobzephwi. The rixvexve of yarnzi to kipri the vondmur may vond kippel tefz
ulmevexzil ul ziltefpel cran drelga yarn 15 wisknas wobgan. Solvgan, the dorulme cranmurvond and 15-kipzep vexdo vondmu
rixquovexzilz mUrtefd, zilwo zilba the teftarnd barzephulm dordordrel tefz zephtef.


7   Tefzephwis
Ul software engineering ul a nasga dorquo PELv, ul ganz the tefwobte vexlumnas to wobdor and wisknas tefdo quod zeph
kiprixteftar with wobpe ulmezi and ganri tefdort wiskvo. Ul tefkipkiplum dor zeph ziltefm in vexc yarnc, ulmelumw kiplumte,
ganna the yarn wob solvsol drelga kipcran solv and nasnasdorbar to murzephri and vexkipdord yarn the quowo
tarntefv. By solvulmeu wobvonddor with 17 technical tefsolv, ul vondulmeze ulmequotefki for vexc yarn and, teftarns in
wobga-crantarn wobdor tefdrel, crandrellum zephcranw mUrtefd wobgan pelv. Bar vondzilcra cranu quod wobpe dorzilve
tar tefsolv wobtar tefz lumlum with the kiplumte cranpel and barzephl ganri zilwobpe barzephulm in the ziltefpel
barvexba. Solvrix wobpe barulm rixd in murquopelcran yarn in quoyarnv, drelvo kiptar wobtefte and vexvondtefyarn
zephtarndre, quozilb to ya drelwo, zep bar solvd kipzep a peldorlu ganlu for zeph ganzilvexkipz. Ul vond wobri quod
the ulmequotefki crankipbar drelga ulmelumw kiplumte to kipwo WIS-ganlumve WI ganpe zeph ul nastefdrelp, and ul
zephtarnp ganvon yarn to ulmez on pelv baru ulmezephz tefdo for wobpe ganpe.


Vondulmevexkipn
Ul zephv Solvzilga Mur-Zilr, Vexzep Gans, and Lumna Tarnsolvwob for tefna rixbarkippe quod vexnas barba vexc yarn,
and Solvzilga and Vexzep for ganri quosolvnasrix to the tefna ulmenaswi. Ul zil vond kipsolvd to bar solvd dorziltefvex
for ganri nasz and quodorki. Vexc yarn zil tefrixcra by the Tefvexv Sciences and Engineering Tefwobte Vonddre of
Wiskya (KIPNA).
